title: LabRescue — Classroom Continuity & Repair
features: Independent browser-persisted cases for three issues, authored low-risk checks with stop/escalation, deterministic editable lesson activity, saved case history, printable handoff and teacher-confirmed resolution with save-failure protection.
limits: Static local-browser proof of concept. No Gemini, AI service, account, technician updates or physical diagnosis. Authored checks are observation-only and defer to school safety rules. Records are device-local and not backed up; no public repository, demo video or deployment is created.
